description: Tony's native Zig TensorFold TP2 lane at 9fa230d3eb119f588e690bf9b87ce41ed902db60, with the pinned bertholomus engine/kit and the creator's sampling, Triton/indexer and rank-cache patches. 262,144-token shared context pool, 4 streams, target-only decoding, image input and byte-checked chat template. Engram shards stay on local NVMe. Read-only source weights derive a per-rank cache and verified RoPE/vision kit under /outputs/cache; restart reuses valid completed work and rebuilds incomplete or malformed derived inputs. The former 115 GiB declaration came from the creator's whole-host 121.7 GiB minus 6.7 GiB free at 1M context, not a recipe-only allocation measurement. Upstream measurements are not physical qualification on this fleet. Admission repair: --no-drafts skips DSpark weight loading and draft buffers on BOTH ranks (weights.zig::load, model.zig::open); credit only 3 GiB of the creator's approximately 3.5 GiB draft weights. Reducing --context/--pool from 1,048,576 to 262,144 removes at least another 1 GiB: prompt.zig::Caches.init uses 890 bytes/position (KV sources 2/8/14 at ratio 2 and 20 at ratio 1, packed 512-wide FP4 plus scales and 128-wide index keys), and model.zig allocates 512 RoPE bytes/position; 786,432 * 1,402 = 1,102,577,664 bytes removed, before smaller round/index workspace. Keep the remaining original allowance: 115 - 3 - 1 = 111 GiB (119,185,342,464 bytes) peak/rank. --prompt-cache-gib=0 prevents additional kept-state snapshots. Engram remains disk-backed, no CPU offload or RAM-fraction cap is substituted. This is a conservative source-backed planning estimate, not measured fleet acceptance.
title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 EXL3 2.9bpw TensorFold TP2 (tonyd2wild)
